inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person (every tier)
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to both sites); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Entry to both sites (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)
